summary: The PR addresses an issue with incorrect (app_label, model) pairs being passed to allow_migrate() during makemigrations, but there are some concerns about test coverage and potential behavioral changes.

issues.description: There are no additional tests added to verify the fix specifically for the issue described. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be included to ensure the fix works as intended.

The change may introduce behavioral regression risk as it alters how allow_migrate() is called. It is important to ensure that existing routers and migration setups will not be adversely affected by this change.
